plugin.name: MiniMax Video
plugin.description: Make videos with MiniMax H3 and H3 Max using your own API key.
plugin.longDescription: Adds separate China and Global video providers. Supports text, first/last frames and up to nine reference images. Stop ends local waiting; the remote task may continue and incur charges. Compatible app versions can move existing MiniMax settings into this plugin.
config.cn.title: China API key
config.cn.description: From platform.minimax.cn → API Keys. Only needed for the China provider.
config.global.title: Global API key
config.global.description: From platform.minimax.io → API Keys. Only needed for the Global provider.
